caveats: Arm B pins the excess to the star's measured (noisy) windowed centroid, so at high f_bg the centered excess inherits the uninjected centroid noise while the screen threshold assumes SNR_eff; centroid-screen Arm B false rejection is conservative (biased high)
injection adds the empirical PSF without extra noise (W3 is background-limited; source shot noise neglected); real blends are extended or coloured, the injected ones are PSF-shaped point sources

the empirical PSF is aligned on noise-locked windowed centroids (shift-and-add), which sharpens a stacked PSF by a few percent at W3 SNR 8-20; its Gaussian-fit FWHM is a slight underestimate, and at 2.75 arcsec pixels the W3 core is close to critically sampled, so the cubic-spline PSF model carries interpolation error

the pixel covariance is assumed stationary and identical (in units of each cutout's scalar variance) for every star; it is estimated from sky annuli only, so source-dependent noise under the star is not modelled

the covariance is regularised (taper, spectral floor, 5% shrinkage towards white noise): the GLS statistic is therefore not exactly chi^2-distributed, and its threshold comes from calibration nulls, not from theory

the conformal level (k+1)/(n_cal+1) is exact for exchangeable scores. Calibration scores are leave-one-out (PSF and covariance rebuilt without the star), withheld scores use all n_cal stars: the two differ by one star in n_cal, an O(1/n_cal) departure from exact exchangeability that is not corrected

the conformal level is MARGINAL over calibration draws: given this one calibration half, the realised false-alarm probability of the frozen threshold is a Beta(k+1, n_cal-k) variate with mean (k+1)/(n_cal+1), so a withheld rate above the level is not by itself a miscalibration

PSF stamps are normalised by their least-squares amplitude against the nominal 6.5 arcsec Gaussian, NOT by their own summed flux as in Gate #2 (that sum is noise-dominated on 2.75 arcsec pixels and its positive-sum selection leaves a pedestal); the stacked PSF wings still carry noise (about 10% of the total flux in the strongly correlated synthetic rehearsal), so the flux inside the 16.5 arcsec aperture differs from the unit sum by that much; both arms inject the same PSF, so they stay matched
Screens A and B keep Gate #2's in-sample calibration scores (like-for-like control); the leave-one-out scores are stored beside them
calibration 'nulls' are isolated Gaia-clean M dwarfs; unseen W3 background sources among them are part of the realistic null, not removed
SNR_eff = w3snr / (1 - f_bg) assumes background-limited photometry of the blend; w3snr is the AllWISE catalog value, not re-measured on unWISE
epoch propagation uses proper motion only; the coadd mean epoch is taken as 2010.5

ruling v0.2.2-R3: the conformal screens request --conformal-alpha (default 0.01, attainable only with at least 99 evaluated calibration stars); when the calibration half cannot attain the request the frozen level is the smallest attainable one, 1 / (n_cal + 1), flagged by frozen_screens.conformal_alpha_fallback with the request kept in conformal_alpha_requested
description: Sprint 3 (v0.2.2): frozen-method blend screens on unsmoothed unWISE W3 coadds (Lang 2014, 2.75 arcsec pixels) of a fresh |b| > 30 deg sample of isolated Gaia DR3 M dwarfs sharing no patch and no star with Gate #1 / Gate #2. Empirical PSF, pixel-noise covariance and every threshold (scalar-variance chi^2, GLS chi^2, conformal order statistic) frozen on the calibration half before any withheld cutout was fetched; withheld two-arm injection (off-center blends vs matched centered excess).

empirical_psf.construction: sky = median(r >= 22 arcsec); Gate #1 windowed centroid (6.5" window); cubic-spline recentring; 15x15 stamps, each divided by its least-squares amplitude against the nominal 6.5" Gaussian (NOT by its own summed flux, as Gate #2 did); pixel-wise median; renormalised to unit sum

allwise_tap.label: NASA/IPAC IRSA TAP (allwise_p3as_psd)
allwise_tap.verified_note: Gate #1 query plus the coadd_id column: returned as text (e.g. '1394p318_ac51') for every row by the v0.2.2-R4 smoke test

full_tiles.status: documented, NOT implemented: a 1.56 deg tile holds calibration and withheld stars together, so downloading one before the freeze would weaken the physical two-stage ordering from 'bytes not fetched' to 'bytes not read'. Needs a planning ruling before use

legacy_survey_viewer.status: rejected for promotion: the viewer resamples onto the requested grid (re-correlating the pixel noise that Screen B measures) and serves no inverse-variance map. Diagnostic use only; layer name unverified

gaia_tap.label: ARI Heidelberg Gaia TAP (gaiadr3.gaia_source, gaiadr3.allwise_best_neighbour)
gaia_tap.verified_note: used unchanged by Gate #1 (b02ec7df820d) and v0.2.1 (9f3740ee71b0); cone, best-neighbour join and isolation queries re-verified by the v0.2.2-R4 smoke test

documented_not_live_verifiable: invvar-m is the per-pixel inverse variance of the img-m coadd in the same units (Lang 2014); a transport test cannot confirm its calibration
one cutout was fetched, so a reply spanning several tiles was not exercised live (the parser's tile choice is covered by the offline tests)
unwise_cutout.expected_reply: gzipped tar archive holding one img-m / invvar-m FITS pair per overlapping tile, cut from the coadd on its native pixel grid (no resampling), each with a TAN WCS; live, the img-m member is a plain .fits and the invvar-m member a gzipped .fits.gz (both accepted by the parser)
unwise_cutout.native_pixel_check: the WCS pixel scale must be 2.75 arcsec within 1e-3, else the cutout is refused

parameters.ra, dec: ICRS degrees: the Gaia DR3 position propagated to epoch 2010.5
parameters.size: cutout side in NATIVE 2.75 arcsec pixels (45 px = 123.75 arcsec)

unwise_cutout.service: unwise.me cutout service, Lang (2014) unWISE coadds, release 'allwise' (the only unWISE release with W3; the NEOWISE-era releases are W1/W2 only)
unwise_cutout.tile_choice: the pair whose tile is the AllWISE coadd_id[:8] of the star when it covers the star with the required margin, otherwise the pair with the largest margin; a reply with no such pair is recorded as unusable, never resampled
verified_by_smoke_test: host and path https://unwise.me/cutout_fits answer over TLS
query keys version / ra / dec / size / bands / file_img_m / file_invvar_m are honoured: size=45 returned a 45 x 45 pixel W3 cutout
the reply is a gzipped tar with members unwise-1394p318-w3-img-m.fits and unwise-1394p318-w3-invvar-m.fits.gz
the tile name equals the first 8 characters of the star's AllWISE coadd_id (1394p318_ac51)
both members carry the same RA---TAN / DEC--TAN WCS with CD = 2.75 arcsec per pixel (measured 2.7500000 arcsec), 32-bit floats, MAGZP 22.5
invvar-m is finite and strictly positive on every pixel of the cutout

fetch.service: live archives (ARI Gaia TAP, IRSA AllWISE TAP, unwise.me cutouts)

centroid_fresh.role: reference: centroid screen at sigma_sys re-measured on this calibration half (reported beside, never replacing, the locked value)

centroid_locked.role: reference: Gate #1 centroid screen at the LOCKED sigma_sys

image_gls_chi2.role: Screen B: GLS-whitened Delta chi^2 (empirical pixel covariance), median-matched chi2(3) threshold
image_gls_chi2.scale_rule: s = median(Delta chi^2_cal) / median(chi2(3)); threshold = s * chi2.isf(FA, 3)

image_gls_conformal.calibration_scores: delta_chi2_gls_loo (leave-one-out: PSF and covariance rebuilt without the star itself)
image_gls_conformal.role: secondary (predeclared 2x2 corner): GLS-whitened Delta chi^2 with the conformal order-statistic threshold
image_gls_conformal.rule: flag when Delta chi^2 > the (k+1)-th largest calibration null; k = floor(alpha (n_cal + 1)) - 1; P(false alarm) = (k + 1) / (n_cal + 1) for exchangeable continuous scores, with no tail-shape assumption

image_scalar_chi2.role: Screen A: scalar-variance Delta chi^2, median-matched chi2(3) threshold (the Gate #2 rule; control for the effect of Atlas smoothing)
image_scalar_chi2.scale_rule: s = median(Delta chi^2_cal) / median(chi2(3)); threshold = s * chi2.isf(FA, 3)

image_scalar_conformal.calibration_scores: delta_chi2_scalar_loo (leave-one-out: PSF and covariance rebuilt without the star itself)
image_scalar_conformal.role: Screen C: scalar-variance Delta chi^2, distribution-free leave-one-out conformal order-statistic threshold
image_scalar_conformal.rule: flag when Delta chi^2 > the (k+1)-th largest calibration null; k = floor(alpha (n_cal + 1)) - 1; P(false alarm) = (k + 1) / (n_cal + 1) for exchangeable continuous scores, with no tail-shape assumption

naive_flux_excess.role: adversarial reference rule (NOT a proposed screen)
naive_flux_excess.rule: flux_ratio - 1 > 3 / SNR, flux_ratio = 1 + (aperture flux - uninjected aperture flux) / F_star, r <= 16.5 arcsec

frozen_screens.snr_eff_rule: SNR_eff = w3snr / (1 - f_bg) (catalog sees the blended flux)

geometry.note: angular extents identical to Gate #2 (its pixel constants x 1.375 arcsec)

noise_model.construction: pooled autocovariance of sky-annulus pixels (r >= 22 arcsec, never the PSF-subtracted core) in units of each cutout's scalar variance; 4-sigma MAD clip + 1 px dilation; cosine taper beyond 0.5 max_lag; power spectrum clipped at 0.001 V(0) on the torus; shrinkage 0.05 towards white noise. Sigma_star = var_star * V is strictly positive definite (eigenvalues >= shrinkage * V(0) * var_star)

patches.allwise_adql: SELECT designation, ra, dec, w3snr, w3mpro, w3sigmpro, cc_flags, ext_flg, nb, na, ph_qual, coadd_id FROM allwise_p3as_psd WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 63.456094, 3.538685, 2.0000)) = 1 AND w3snr >= 8 AND w3snr <= 20
patches.gaia_adql: SELECT gs.source_id, gs.ra, gs.dec, gs.l, gs.b, gs.pmra, gs.pmdec, gs.ref_epoch, gs.parallax, gs.parallax_over_error, gs.bp_rp, gs.phot_g_mean_mag, gs.ruwe, xm.original_ext_source_id FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS gs JOIN gaiadr3.allwise_best_neighbour AS xm ON gs.source_id = xm.source_id WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', gs.ra, gs.dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 63.456094, 3.538685, 2.0000)) AND gs.parallax > 3.3333 AND gs.parallax_over_error > 10 AND gs.bp_rp >= 1.84 AND gs.phot_g_mean_mag BETWEEN 10 AND 16

cuts_in_order: exclude published Hephaistos candidates (adversary claim file)
no other Gaia DR3 source within 15 arcsec
selection.disjointness: 0 of 252 fresh Gaia DR3 ids among the 154 locked Gate #1 / Gate #2 controls
selection.gaia: parallax > 3.3333 mas (d < 300 pc), parallax_over_error > 10, BP-RP >= 1.84, 10 <= G <= 16, AllWISE best neighbour (gaiadr3.allwise_best_neighbour)
selection.isolation_adql_template: SELECT source_id, phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', {ra:.7f}, {dec:.7f}, {r:.7f}))
selection.split: stratified by patch, alternating labels, SeedSequence([42, 2])

injection.arm_a: off-center blend at separation theta from the star's measured image centroid, seeded azimuth
injection.arm_b: matched centered excess: identical F_bg at theta = 0 (the star's measured image centroid)
injection.background_flux: F_bg = F_star f_bg / (1 - f_bg); F_star = PSF-fit flux of the uninjected star at its windowed centroid
injection.noise: none added (W3 is background-limited; source shot noise neglected)
injection.template: empirical PSF (calibration stars only), cubic spline

centroid_fresh.role: reference: centroid screen at sigma_sys re-measured on this calibration half (reported beside, never replacing, the locked value)

centroid_locked.role: reference: Gate #1 centroid screen at the LOCKED sigma_sys

image_gls_chi2.role: Screen B: GLS-whitened Delta chi^2 (empirical pixel covariance), median-matched chi2(3) threshold

image_gls_conformal.role: secondary (predeclared 2x2 corner): GLS-whitened Delta chi^2 with the conformal order-statistic threshold

image_scalar_chi2.role: Screen A: scalar-variance Delta chi^2, median-matched chi2(3) threshold (the Gate #2 rule; control for the effect of Atlas smoothing)

image_scalar_conformal.role: Screen C: scalar-variance Delta chi^2, distribution-free leave-one-out conformal order-statistic threshold

naive_flux_excess.role: adversarial reference rule (NOT a proposed screen)

summary.survival_weighting: p(theta) ~ theta for theta <= 3.25 arcsec, uniform f_bg
